name: SmartHome Video
description: Smart home video monitoring plugin with motion detection, VLM summarization, and daily reports.

monitors.description: Per-source monitor configurations keyed by source_id.

dbPath.description: Path to the SQLite database for this monitor.

recordingsDir.description: Directory where continuous recordings are stored.
